title: M7a route adapter proof and switch readiness report
instructions: Read the accepted M6 switch proposal, M6 rollback dry-run, M5 quality gate, and quality-passed manifest. Read-only check whether metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json exists. Search the project for any existing production query-entry adapter or routing consumer. Build a route-proof tool that evaluates an artifact-local candidate query-entry pointer and classifies inside-window, outside-window, boundary, invalid-date, and missing-date cases. Inside 2026-05-01 <= trade_date < 2026-06-01 must route to the quality-passed Parquet manifest; outside that window must route to source-duckdb fallback; invalid or missing dates must be rejected or unresolved. The tool may create only route-proof and readiness artifacts under .ai-coord/artifacts. If no production adapter/consumer exists, readiness must be blocked-for-production-switch even if artifact-local route proof passes. Do not write metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Do not write data/clean/daily_basic/_current.json. Do not modify target Parquet or the quality-passed clean manifest. Do not create M7b/M8 task files. Write route-proof and switch-readiness artifacts, then finish for Claude review.
summary: M7a route-proof tool and artifacts generated. Artifact-local candidate routes 2026-05 window to the quality-passed Parquet manifest, outside-window dates to source-duckdb fallback, invalid dates rejected, and missing dates unresolved. Switch readiness remains blocked-for-production-switch because no production query-entry adapter/consumer exists and production metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json is absent. No production pointer, _current, manifest, Parquet, source DuckDB, M7b, or M8 writes were performed.
